obs: "The expression, 'the capacity of his distillery as estimated according to law,' clearly refers to the real capacity as thus ascertained, and not to a fictitious capacity for any particular day or days."

“To appreciate why this is so, consider the sentencing guidelines Congress cross-referenced in subparagraphs (A) through (C). They set forth a two-step process for calculating a defendant’s criminal history.” … “Now return to subparagraph (A). It provides that the defendant must not have more than 4 criminal history points … as determined under the sentencing guidelines.”
